option_relations.rationale: Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC) is related to SUFU-related Nevoid Basal Cell Carcinoma Syndrome due to the presence of a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene.
Infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma is a type of skin cancer, but it does not match the clinical presentation and genetic findings in the vignette.

Basal cell nevus syndrome (Gorlin syndrome) is another name for Gorlin Syndrome (Basal Cell Nevus Syndrome), which is a known genetic disorder that increases the risk of developing basal cell carcinomas.
